changelog:
Orion 3.10 — settings that do something, no orb, friendlier.

THE ORB IS GONE. Orion's stage is his picture now — the character you
picked, breathing, blinking, and talking live when he speaks. No
picture picked yet? The stage says so in plain words and points you
to the Avatar Studio. The "orb" face option is gone from Voice &
Face, and the Terminal's floating bubble button is gone too — its
help panel opens from a normal button in the flow.

THE GRAPHICS SWITCH WORKS NOW. The Persona & Style graphics
direction used to save and show but change nothing — nothing in the
app read it. Now everything Orion builds (sites, apps, games,
galleries) is built to your direction, and the build steps say so.

LEARNING YOU CAN SEE. The Skills page now shows the lessons Orion
has banked — every failure and correction, what happened, why, and
what he does differently — read fresh from the real store, plus how
many topics his built-in API has self-learned. Teaching was landing
all along; now you can watch it.

CLEANED UP. The Vault's "Key pages" buttons (GitHub/Vercel/
Cloudflare pages Orion never used) are removed. Orion talks warmer
everywhere — persona, prompts, and empty states.

GRAPHICS, TURNED ALL THE WAY UP. His picture on the stage now
renders at extremely high quality: re-rendered at 1368 by 1026 or
higher — double the old 684 by 513 in each direction — at your
phone's full resolution, with sharper stage geometry, finer glow
and dust, and the same extremely-high standard written into every
visual build the makers produce.

THE GOD FORGE. The generator has its name now: every made thing is
stamped Made by The God Forge. It also gained a search-engine
maker — ask for a search engine for your recipes and you get a
real ranked index, seeded for the job, that saves on your phone
and reads back. Databases, clouds, and servers are still built by
your paired server API — they need a real server to run on — and
Orion says so plainly instead of faking them in the app. His
carried knowledge pack is synced to the newest version too.
